SELECT DM.SUBSCRIBER_ID + '00' as MEMBERNUMBER,FMHC.ANSWER AS SCREENER_COMPLETED_DATE FROM APP_CAEDM.DW_DIM_HRA DH 	INNER JOIN APP_CAEDM.DW_FACT_MEMBER_HRA FMH ON DH.HRA_KEY = FMH.HRA_KEY 		AND DH.HRA_ID = 2182 	INNER JOIN APP_CAEDM.DW_FACT_MEMBER_HRA_CONCEPT FMHC ON FMHC.MEMBER_HRA_KEY = FMH.MEMBER_HRA_KEY 		AND FMHC.ANSWER IS NOT NULL 	INNER JOIN APP_CAEDM.DW_DIM_HRA_CONCEPT_CONFIG DHCC ON FMHC.HRA_CONCEPT_CONFIG_KEY = DHCC.HRA_CONCEPT_CONFIG_KEY 	INNER JOIN APP_CAEDM.DW_DIM_CONCEPT DC ON DC.CONCEPT_KEY = DHCC.CONCEPT_KEY 		AND DC.CONCEPT_ID = 573802 	INNER JOIN APP_CAEDM.DW_DIM_MEMBER DM ON FMH.MEME_CK = DM.MEME_CK
